subject: science
title: Growing and Changing
about: Life cycles in order and 'what comes next': egg, caterpillar, chrysalis, butterfly; egg, tadpole, frog; seed, sprout, plant, flower; egg, chick, chicken; baby, child, grown-up, plus baby animal names and that young animals grow up to look like their parents. Life cycles are a Grade 2 topic in NC's 2023 science standards; this bridge deck sits under LS.1.1.1 because a living thing can only grow and change when its basic needs are met.
tip: Say a life cycle out loud together and stop before the last step: egg, tadpole, then what? Let him finish it.

cards.q: A butterfly's life starts as a tiny egg on a leaf. What hatches out of the egg?
cards.note: The tiny caterpillar eats the leaf it hatched on.

cards.q: A caterpillar eats and grows. Then it makes a hard case around itself. What is the case called?
cards.note: Say KRIS-uh-lis. Inside it, the caterpillar changes into a butterfly. A moth spins a cocoon instead.

cards.q: Egg, caterpillar, chrysalis. What comes next?
cards.note: The butterfly comes out of the chrysalis with wet wings and lets them dry.

cards.q: Which comes first in a butterfly's life, the egg or the caterpillar?
cards.note: A grown butterfly lays eggs, and the cycle starts all over again.

cards.q: A frog lays its eggs in the water. What hatches out?
cards.note: A tadpole has a tail and breathes with gills, like a fish.
A tadpole swims and eats in a pond until it grows legs.

cards.q: A tadpole grows legs and its tail gets shorter. What is it turning into?
cards.note: Back legs grow first, then front legs. Then the frog can hop onto land.

cards.q: A seed gets water and warmth. A tiny green shoot pops up. What do we call it?
cards.note: A sprout is a baby plant.

cards.q: Seed, sprout, plant. What comes next?
cards.note: The flower makes new seeds, and the cycle starts again.

cards.q: Seed, sprout, plant, flower, then seeds again. What do we call this?
cards.note: A life cycle goes round and round, like a circle.

cards.q: A hen sits on her eggs to keep them warm. What hatches out?
cards.note: The chick pecks a hole in the shell to get out.

cards.q: A fluffy yellow chick grows up. What does it become?
cards.note: A grown-up girl chicken is a hen. A grown-up boy chicken is a rooster.

cards.q: Which comes first, a baby or a child?
cards.note: Every grown-up was a baby once.
You are a child now. One day you will be a grown-up.

cards.q: What happens to your body as you grow up?
cards.note: Mark your height on a door frame and watch the marks climb.

cards.q: What do we call a baby cat?
cards.note: A baby cow is a calf and a baby sheep is a lamb.

cards.q: What do we call a baby dog?
cards.note: A puppy grows into a dog in about one year.

cards.q: A kitten grows up. What does it look like?
cards.note: Young animals grow up to look like their parents, but not exactly the same.
